status: FROZEN before any M1 step (amendment A0)
spec: SP/calls_spec/spec.md Revision 2 (sections 7.2, 7.3, 7.4); engine branch engine/calls-k5 on f960ceb (K2 head)

pilot.world: alife run --preset mini3s --overlay stormsph22h --overlay comm --overlay calls (the overlays now carry the values below), fresh founders, --weather-spinup 8000, seed 0 for the pilot runs

gpu_hours.note: two runs in parallel (about 101 steps/s each, 153 alone); 57 jobs

weather.storm_u0.evidence: three lineages at far_xref 8.0: 6.13, 6.46, 6.32 %; 0.05 gave 3.68 % at far_xref 3.0, the lower edge; 0.045 gave 4.55 %
weather.storm_u0.note: the hazard-off control is weather.storm_p=0; the shipped 0.095 is the second negative control

calls.far_xref.evidence: median heard, storm channel, audible rows, three lineages, 60 000 / 80 000 steps: 0.41 / 0.44, 0.40 / 0.35, 0.20 / 0.22. At 0.04: 3.0 saturates (0.92), 6 gives 0.12 / 0.38, 10 gives 0.28 / 0.32
calls.far_xref.caveat: one lineage of three is below [0.3, 0.7]; the statistic depends on the evolved world

calls.far_range.source: spec 6 (least value the 4-column rule admits on mini3s is 17.9)
calls.far_range.note: the columns sit on the floor sphere: horizontal distances are stretched by 1.27 to 1.28 on average (mean altitude 12.8 to 13.4 of 24); see M3 in results.md. In the shell far_range 18 means about 14 (12 to 25 % less)
calls.far_range.decision: M3: kept on the floor sphere and recorded; every arm shares the geometry, the table is not rebuilt

calls.events.note: hurt + storm, comm.width 2, D_IN 95, token calls2@1 (asserted by the launcher for every arm)

calls.hold.source: unchanged; gate G2 holds: open share of alive rows (last 20 000 steps of the chosen run) hurt 10.4 %, storm 6.8 %, band 0.5 to 25 %

calls.oracle_min.note: R and Rn are quoted with this and with calls.oracle_gain 1.0 and far_xref 3.0

noise.source: null forks of P1_u05_x3 at step 80 000, 20 000 steps, control none, run.seed 1 to 6 (SP/calls_pilot/null_out.txt, pnull_out.txt, paired6_out.txt)

unpaired_different_seed.note: the spec's null: different run.seed, which also changes the weather after the fork
unpaired_different_seed.h_leq_2p5_percent_needs: about 19 forks of 20 000 steps (12.7 of 30 000) per arm, i.e. about 380 000 fork-steps per arm: not affordable

paired_same_seed.note: forks with the same run.seed share the weather exactly (verified: wind_max_l1 and rain_total identical); contrasts of the knock-out forks are paired by seed
paired_same_seed.lower_bound_same_seed_perturbation: comm.cost 32.001 against 32, six seeds: sd of the paired contrast 0.47 %, a lower bound (common random numbers keep the runs close)
paired_same_seed.h_leq_2p5_percent: holds for 3 seed pairs of 20 000 steps (1.8 %), and is expected to hold for 3 pairs of 30 000 steps (about 1.4 %, scaling as T^-1/2, not measured)

noise.rule_5_percent_valid_only_if_h_leq_2p5_p: FAILS for the unpaired null and for 3 lineages (h 8 %); holds within one lineage; needs about 9 lineages

between_lineages.source: forks of L10, L11, L12, 20 000 steps, seeds 1 and 2
between_lineages.caveat: sd from three lineages at 80 000 steps is rough

smallest_effect_of_interest.valid_under: lineage as the unit of inference, n chosen by the rule in design

pilot_reading_of_the_contrast_M1_will_te.F_vs_nofar_6_seeds_paired_20k: nofar has +1.91 % storm deaths per agent-step (per seed +1.6 +4.0 +3.1 +0.8 +2.2 -0.3; 95 % CI +0.29 to +3.53), i.e. F reduces them by 1.9 %, below 5 %. F is the 80 000-step evolved population of one seed

smallest_effect_of_interest.upper_bound_on_any_benefit: storm deaths are 6.1 to 6.5 % of all deaths at the chosen values

pilot_reading_at_chosen_values.decoy_storm: +7.1 % (per lineage +4.1, +12.3, +4.9), all six pairs positive; population not lower

block_structure.source: autocorrelation of storm deaths per 500 steps in the null forks (null_out.txt) and of the paired log-ratio (pnull_out.txt)
block_structure.holm_family: 4 readouts (storm death rate, population, births per agent-step, mean energy) x 2 contrasts (F vs nofar, F vs decoy) = 8
block_structure.note: the spec expected 4 to 6 blocks of 5 000 to 7 500 steps; the data decorrelate by about 2 500 steps. A stationary block bootstrap with mean block 2 500 is the alternative
block_structure.decision: the lineage is the unit of inference; one fork per lineage; blocks do not enter the interval, because they read 1.5 times less noise than seeds; 5 000-step blocks are reported only as a within-lineage description

oracle.note: R is an upper bound on exposure reduction, not on net benefit (Revision 2). Net-fitness readouts are in results.md. Quoted at far_xref 3.0, oracle_min 0.05, oracle_gain 1.0 unless stated; seeds 1 and 2; relative change against none (same seed), mean of the two

R_curve_oracle_gain.columns: [storm deaths per agent-step, n_alive], relative to none

reflex_call_control.note: calling at 0.5 with no force changes nothing measurable

oracle.refutation_clause: no oracle setting lowers storm deaths by 20 % or more without a population cost, except reflex_near at gain 1 (-28 % storm deaths, population -2.4 %, births per agent-step +8 %); read the clause of 7.4 with that

at_chosen_values.columns: [storm deaths per agent-step, n_alive] for L10, L11, L12, fork seed 1

G4.value: ledger error 0 in every row of 57 runs, full_check OK on the P1 checkpoint and a reflex fork, no error bit of diag; the advisory WEATHER_WARN bit is set in every weather run

G5.result: PASS on the first clause; net fitness falls
G5.value: reflex -27 to -53 % storm deaths, n_alive -69 to -80 %; reflex_near -26 to -32 %, n_alive -3 to -10 %

departures_from_spec: storm_u0 0.04 and far_xref 8.0 from the pilot's extension

the lineage is the unit of inference: the seed rule with block intervals is replaced by the t over lineages, because the effect varies more between lineages (3.2 to 4.5 %) than within one (1.1 %) and blocks read 1.5 times less noise than seeds
the fitness clause uses no blocks (spec 7.3 item 3)
seeds may be added under stage_2_rule (spec 7.4: 'seeds added until it is')
M3: far table kept on the floor sphere, every arm shares the geometry

design.not_reused: the pilot's lineages (seeds 0, 10, 11, 12) enter no M1 estimate

references.D: comm.control=deaf from step 0, seed 21, stage 1 only

design.forks: from step 300 000 of each F lineage: none, nofar, deaf, decoy, 30 000 steps, run.seed = the lineage seed in every arm of that lineage, one fork per arm

stage_2_rule.statistic: sd over lineages of log(storm deaths per agent-step, arm / none) over the whole fork, for nofar and for decoy; the larger of the two
stage_2_rule.n: the smallest n in 3..9 with t(0.975, n-1) * sd / sqrt(n) <= 0.025; 9 if none
stage_2_rule.blind: the sd is used, never the mean or sign of a contrast
stage_2_rule.once: applied once, after stage 1; lineages are added in the listed order and none is dropped
stage_2_rule.scope: pre-authorised by the owner's go; M2 is not

design.reading: O1 from the last 20 000 steps of each long run; O4 from the forks; O2 and O3 from voice logs replayed from the checkpoints once the K3 analysis exists, under this same file

world: alife run --preset mini3s --overlay stormsph22h --overlay comm --overlay calls --weather-spinup 8000 --metrics-every 500 --checkpoint-every 100000; every launch asserts D_IN 95, token calls2@1, storm_u0 0.04, far_xref 8.0

outcomes.O1: spec 7.4: calls_rate_storm of each F lineage above the D reference by at least 0.05, last 20 000 steps. A lineage that uses the hurt channel fails O1 and is reported as such. Hazard-off at the same rate as F means the rate is no response to the hazard

O4.primary: relative reduction of storm deaths per agent-step, F against nofar and F against decoy, reported separately; both must pass for a claim of meaning
O4.estimate: 1 - exp(-m), m the mean log ratio over lineages
O4.interval: Student t over lineages, df n - 1, one-sided 95 % lower bound on the reduction above 0
O4.bands: >= 15 %: supported; 5 to 15 %: supported, small; below 5 %: no effect of interest
O4.holm: population, births per agent-step and mean energy with the storm rate: 4 readouts x 2 contrasts = 8, one-sided t p-values over lineages
O4.validity: the 5 % band is read as valid only if the final h <= 2.5 %; if n = 9 and h is still above, the result is reported with its h and the band is not claimed

outcomes.refutation: spec 7.4 Revision 2; at the chosen values the oracle's net fitness falls, so R licenses no refutation
